up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4818987. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and finally to compound_structures on molregno. Filter where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4818987'. Output exactly: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4818987'
